scenes.title: Table Discussion and Preparation
scenes.rationale: One out-of-game opening block covers play preferences, shared worldbuilding, and character preparation; keeping it separate prevents these conversations from becoming adventure events.

scenes.title: Leaving Orenlas
scenes.rationale: Aboard Vindristjarna, the party establishes its remaining mission, learns that the threat is growing, and chooses a faster approach while Faldrak follows with the ship.

scenes.title: Scouting the Ash Storm
scenes.rationale: Arrival establishes a new situation at the storm perimeter: the party remotely scouts the city and tests the ash to learn how it can enter safely.

scenes.title: A Dragon in the Ruins
scenes.rationale: Planning, carrying out, and returning from the sample-collection expedition form one objective with Wellby and Kenzo as the active scouting pair.

scenes.title: The Mirror and the Feast
scenes.rationale: Back together outside the storm, the party studies the sample, chooses the river target, and prepares its camp and feast for the attack; this closes the first day.

scenes.title: Battle at the River
scenes.rationale: The next morning's approach and all five combat phases belong to the same objective: confronting the river concentration and severing its connection to the central ooze.

scenes.title: The Collapsed Plaza
scenes.rationale: Rumbling after the river victory drives recovery and pursuit toward the well, ending with the collapsed plaza and the newly exposed central mass; the next fight has not begun.
